why: Same notions on both sides (the project's IsSck, Mathlib ContDiffOn on U_{m+l}); B's levelTo f (m+l) m is definitionally invFun ι_m ∘ f ∘ ι_{m+l} = levelMap f m ∘ inclK m l, so A ⇒ B is glue plus IsRelOpenInQuadrant.isScDomain. B ⇒ A fails for a genuine reason: every conjunct of A is stated for an arbitrary IsScDomain U (level-wise open ∩ convex with unique differentiability, e.g. a closed disc in ℝ², which is not relatively open in any partial quadrant), while B only covers relatively open subsets of partial quadrants. Restricted to those domains, A's most general conjunct contDiffOn_levels' (arbitrary compatible ρ : E_n → E_m) does follow from B (B_to_levels'_quadrant, rt_check OK, taking V = C' = F₀), so the only gap is the domain class. B's extra hypotheses (V relatively open, f(U) ⊆ V) are only used for its MapsTo conjunct.
